mapper.select: SELECT s.spending_no, s.member_no, s.category_no, c.category_name, s.amount, s.merchant, s.pay_method, s.memo, s.spending_date FROM spending s INNER JOIN spending_category c ON s.category_no = c.category_no WHERE s.member_no = #{param1} AND DATE_FORMAT(s.spending_date, '%Y-%m') = #{param2} ORDER BY s.spending_date

SELECT e.expected_no, e.member_no, e.category_no, c.category_name, e.expected_amount, e.merchant, e.memo, e.expected_date FROM expected_spending e INNER JOIN spending_category c ON e.category_no = c.category_no WHERE e.member_no = #{param1} AND DATE_FORMAT(e.expected_date, '%Y-%m') = #{param2} ORDER BY e.expected_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expected_spending(member_no, category_no, expected_amount, expected_date, merchant, memo) VALUES (#{memberNo}, #{categoryNo}, #{expectedAmount}, #{expectedDate}, #{merchant}, #{memo})
mapper.update: UPDATE expected_spending SET category_no = #{categoryNo}, expected_amount = #{expectedAmount}, expected_date = #{expectedDate}, merchant = #{merchant}, memo = #{memo} WHERE expected_no = #{expectedNo}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM expected_spending WHERE expected_date < CURDATE()
